The 95% leave with a free video

Nothing to qualify them live

Your application waits for people to find it

Reach on the algorithm’s terms

147k followers, 2.4k views a reel

3,769 posts and four a week, yet the last seven reels averaged 2.4k views. Posting more won’t fix that. There’s no way to put your best message in front of the right people on demand.

Anyone not ready to apply for 1:1 today leaves with a free video, and you have no way to tell who’s ready next.

Sound familiar?

You know what you want. You just haven’t started.

  • You’ve had the same idea for months, maybe years, and it’s still “not the right time”.
  • You research, plan and tweak, and call it preparation.
  • You wait to feel confident first, and the confidence never quite arrives.
  • You watch other people go for it with half your ideas, and wonder what they know that you don’t.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

The four roadblocks between you and action

What actually stops people starting, and how to spot which one is running your week.

The real reason you put things off

Why procrastination is rarely about laziness, and what it’s protecting you from.

Why you don’t need confidence to start

How confidence is built by taking action, not something you wait for before it.

Change the perception, change the result

A simple reframe to see the thing you’re avoiding differently, so the first step feels smaller.

Leave with one clear, small action you’ll take before the replay even lands in your inbox.
